scenarios.title: UC-00 · Normal Sinus Rhythm
scenarios.description: Maintain VVI standby pacing while observing intrinsic beats.
scenarios.objective: Confirm the pacemaker remains inhibited while the patient maintains an intrinsic sinus rate.
scenarios.feedback: No pacing spikes should be visible. If pacing occurs, lower the rate below the intrinsic rhythm or verify sensing leads.

rules.description: Loss of capture when rate exceeds the intrinsic rhythm without adequate output

effects.feedback: Increase the pacing output until capture returns, then add a 2 mA safety margin.
